summary: Added a requirement for account lockout after failed login attempts based on domain knowledge. Enhanced the 'Forgot Password' acceptance criterion to clarify the reset token behavior. Also added a clarification about email verification gating checkout, which impacts user experience and security.

additions.description: The system must lock an account temporarily after five consecutive failed login attempts.
additions.rationale: This prevents brute-force attacks and protects user accounts from unauthorized access.

additions.description: The system must invalidate a password reset token immediately after it is used once.
additions.rationale: This ensures that reset tokens cannot be reused, maintaining the security of the password recovery process.

additions.description: The system must require email verification before allowing a user to proceed with checkout.
additions.rationale: This ensures that order confirmations and shipping updates can be reliably sent to a valid email address.

modifications.original_description: When the user clicks the 'Forgot Password' link, they must be directed to the password recovery initiation page.
modifications.enhanced_description: When the user clicks the 'Forgot Password' link, they must be directed to the password recovery initiation page, where they can enter their email address and receive a time-limited reset token via email.
modifications.rationale: The enhanced description clarifies the expected behavior of the password recovery flow, including token handling and delivery.
